repo.description: Repository identifier: remote slug when available, else the absolute worktree path.

packageManager.description: Detected package manager and version when applicable, e.g. "pnpm@9".

source.description: Where the commands came from; "mixed" when rungs differ, with per-check detail in each command.

checks.description: Each check in execution order. A rung the repo lacks appears as not-applicable; a rung deliberately not run appears as skipped with a note. Absent entries are a broken report.

evidenceDir.description: Temp directory holding full captured output per check.

treeClean.description: git status --porcelain empty after the run, ignoring build artifacts the repo's own commands produce.

cwd.description: Directory the command ran in, repo-relative.

outputTail.description: The decisive output, quoted verbatim; full capture lives in evidenceDir.

note.description: Required for skipped and not-applicable results: why.
